newsitem.title: UK: S&P names emerging markets manager, Europe director.
newsitem.headline: S&P names emerging markets manager, Europe director.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it appointed George Dallas to manage emerging markets operations of Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and has also named Francois Verveka as managing director of Europe.

S&P said Dallas will direct marketing, sales and product development efforts in those regions and will work closely with the heads of S&P's European business units and with executives from Standard & Poor's Financial Information Services. Verveka, who will assume Dallas' previous role as managing director of Europe, will lead the development of S&P's ratings business in a market now served by a network of five offices and 200 people.

"Markets in these countries are changing and expanding rapidly, and demand for risk evaluations and information is high, especially in the banking, utility and governmental sectors," said Leo O'Neill, Standard & Poor's President and Chief Rating Officer.

S&P said Verveka's appointment comes at a time when the proposed European economic and monetary union (EMU) is expected to generate more demand for credit ratings and risk analysis across European financial markets.
In addition, S&P said Jock Paton, director for Africa and the Middle East and Claude Chaubet-Bride, associate director for Eastern Europe, will report to Dallas.
